The search returned nothing. There are no error-level Splunk entries for GUID hq7wz in the 48 hours ending 2026-06-21T00:00:00Z.

What that lets us conclude is narrow: no AAP2 component logged an error against this GUID in that window, at that level, in the index this search covers.

What it does not let us conclude is anything about why the sandbox failed. An empty error search is not evidence of a cause. It is equally consistent with the provision failing in a way that logged at WARN or INFO rather than ERROR, with the failure happening outside this window, with the GUID being wrong or mistyped, or with the failure occurring before anything was tagged with the GUID at all. I am not going to pick one of those and present it as the finding.

What I would do next: re-run the search over a wider window and without errors_only, so WARN and INFO entries are included; and independently, look the provision up on the AAP2 side with query_aap2 and on the Babylon side for its AnarchySubject, since either will say whether a provision job ran for this GUID at all. That distinction -- no logs versus no job -- is the thing worth establishing before anyone diagnoses further.
